links.outcome: Discrimination across independent centers and prospective real-world evaluation
links.effect: AUC up to 0.996 in multicenter validation; AUC 0.969 in prospective evaluation of 58,481 unselected records, maintaining robust accuracy.
links.quote: In a prospective real‑world evaluation of 58,481 unselected records, it maintained robust accuracy (AUC = 0.969), identifying occult leukemia and early relapse in non‑hematology departments.

unlisted_practices: Using interpretable, pathophysiology-grounded features for opportunistic screening from routine CBC tests

screen.reason: Evaluates a real-time opportunistic screening model (LeukoAlert) on prospective unselected real-world patient records across departments, demonstrating real deployment performance.
